item.title: Trump Announces New Round Of Tariffs On Everyone Who Didn't Laugh At His Jokes In Davos
item.description: DAVOS — One day after his speech that made headlines at a gathering of world leaders at the World Economic Forum, U.S. President Donald Trump announced a new round of tariffs on everyone who didn't laugh at his jokes.

item.title: Pro Athlete Struck By Lightning After Failing To Thank Jesus Christ For Victory
item.description: U.S. — Tragedy unfolded at a sporting event over the weekend, as a professional athlete was struck by lightning after unexcusably failing to thank Jesus Christ for giving his team the victory in the game.

item.title: Pam Bondi Says She Has Finally Figured Out What DOJ Stands For
item.description: U.S. — Attorney General Pam Bondi has announced that after almost a year on the job, she has finally figured out what the acronym "DOJ" stands for.

item.title: Exhausted White Liberal Women Clock In For Another Long Day Protecting Migrant Sex Offenders
item.description: MINNEAPOLIS, MN — Another long day of work was on the docket, as white liberal women clocked in for another long day of protesting the arrest of migrant sex offenders.

item.title: Ms. Rachel Apologizes For Accidentally Spray-Painting 'Go Away Jews' On A Synagogue
item.description: NEW YORK, NY — The woman behind YouTube's most popular and beloved educational content for children found herself in hot water, as Ms. Rachel issued a public apology for accidentally spray-painting "GO AWAY JEWS" on a synagogue.

item.title: Apple Engineers Working Feverishly To Somehow Make Next iOS Update Even Worse
item.description: CUPERTINO, CA — Sources within Apple's Software Engineering Division confirmed that their team was working around the clock to make the next iOS update even worse than the current one.

item.title: 'Sinners' Nominated For 'Best Movie We Have To Nominate Or Else We Will Be Called Racist'
item.description: HOLLYWOOD, CA — The Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences released its list of Oscar nominees for 2026, with Sinners being nominated for "Best Movie We Have To Nominate Or Else We Will Be Called Racist."
